DOC-01.details: Covers login, catalogue, place order, duplicate handling and order tracking (with courier). No returns, settlement report or balance.

DOC-02.details: Full request/response examples for every endpoint; Product Details example is marked 'abridged'.

DOC-03.details: orders_status_id / orders_status: only one example value (10, 'In Production'); the full list is not given.

DOC-04.details: No date, version or owner on the page.

AUTH-01.details: Authentication section: JWT via Firebase OAuth 2.0. Every call sends Authorization: Bearer <token> plus client-id and client-secret headers; curl examples given.

AUTH-02.details: GET method=generate_token&corporate_id=... with client-secret, client-id, user-name headers returns access_token. Token lifetime is not stated.

AUTH-03.details: Errors table: 401 when token, client-id or client-secret is missing, invalid or expired; 'Generate a fresh token and retry'.

ENV-01.details: Environments table: Sandbox https://www.psstaging.in; Production 'TBD (shared at go-live)'. Credentials shared separately.

ENV-03.details: No way to move a sandbox order through statuses is described.

ENV-05.details: Country is a numeric code; only 99 = India is listed. Prices shown in Rs. Other countries/currencies not stated.

CAT-02.details: Listings return 'total' and a data array; no page or limit parameters are documented.

CAT-03.details: Place Order product.product_id is 'ID of the product to be ordered (from Catalog API)'; size_id from Product Details.

CAT-04.details: Product Details: product_name, product_long_des, product_images, category_id, visible. No exact price field, no currency field, no brand field.

CAT-05.details: product_size array; pass size_id in Place Order. Personalisation templates give template_id and block names.

CAT-11.details: price_defining_method 'Range Based With Multiplication'; short description 'Ranging from Rs. 925 to Rs. 1075'. Exact price per size is not returned.

CAT-12.details: category_id, product_long_des, product_features, HSN and tax details per product.

CAT-14.details: Some stores allow one order per user (see Duplicate Order Handling); create_user has numorders. No max quantity per product.

CAT-16.details: Product Details field list names every attribute (images, descriptions, sizes, templates, taxes).

PRC-01.details: Only a price range in HTML text; tax rates given separately (CGST/SGST/IGST). The amount we will be charged per order is not stated.

PRC-02.details: Prices shown as 'Rs.' in text; no currency code field.

PRC-04.details: GST rates and HSN per product are returned; shipping charges not mentioned.

ORD-01.details: POST method=order with profile, product, template, shipping/billing objects; required/optional flags and types in tables; full example body.

ORD-03.details: Success response fully shown: success, status, orders_id.

ORD-04.details: Returns orders_id immediately, then statuses like 'In Production' via Track Order. Not stated whether the order is confirmed at placement.

ORD-05.details: profile: first_name, last_name, email, mobile_number (+ company_name, corporate_id we can fill as constants); shipping: address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, pincode, country. All derivable from our shipping fields.

ORD-06.details: Country = numeric code (99 India), state as name, pincode as string. Phone format not stated.

ORD-08.details: last_name and company_name marked Required; address_line_2 optionality not stated.

ORD-09.details: product is a single object with no quantity field: looks like one item per order. Needs confirmation.

ORD-16.details: Personalisation template (name, employee number, image) per order.

IDM-01.details: profile.reference_number 'Unique reference number for the order', but Optional, and not returned by Track Order. Order lookup is only by orders_id.

IDM-02.details: Duplicate returns HTTP 409 with existing orders [ids], but only for 'one order per user' stores; not keyed on our reference_number.

IDM-03.details: Retry guidance: 'call Track Order, or rely on the 409'. Track Order needs orders_id, which we do not have after a timeout, so this only works on one-order-per-user stores.

STS-01.details: Track Order returns orders_status_id and orders_status, but only one example value is given (10, 'In Production'). Full list needed.

STS-02.details: Only 'In Production' can be mapped so far (to CONFIRMED).

STS-03.details: POST method=order_status&orders_id=... returns status, due date, delivery date and tracking fields.

STS-05.details: Terminal statuses not defined; orders_due_date gives a committed date.

STS-09.details: Dates like '17 Jul, 2024' (orders_date_finished, orders_due_date, actual_delivery_date); timezone not stated.

WHK-01.details: No webhooks described. Polling via Track Order is available instead.

POL-01.details: Track Order (method=order_status) can be called on a schedule per order.

POL-02.details: Status field is orders_status (plus orders_status_id), at the top level of the response.

POL-03.details: Single-order lookup only; no bulk status endpoint; allowed polling rate not stated.

TRK-01.details: Track Order: tracking_number and shipping_company, blank until dispatched.

TRK-03.details: orders_due_date (committed due date); actual_delivery_date once delivered.

TRK-05.details: product_production_days per size; delivery days after dispatch not stated.

TRK-06.details: actual_delivery_date only; no proof of delivery.

ERR-02.details: Error shape {success, status, message, orders}; success is the string "true" on success but boolean false on error.

ERR-05.details: 500: retry after some time. Order timeout: do not blindly retry; check Track Order or the 409 first.

SEC-02.details: create_user sends email, phone and address as URL query parameters; no data-handling policy stated.

SEC-03.details: client-id, client-secret and token are sent as headers.

SEC-07.details: Only placeholders ([Client Secret], [Client ID]); sample token is truncated; real values shared separately.

SUP-03.details: Mentions 'feature flag or versioned behaviour' for the 401-to-409 change; no versioning or deprecation policy.

SUP-05.details: Only an HTML page; no Postman collection or OpenAPI file linked.
